data.description: A recent report revealed that the global unemployment rate rose to 6.5% in the last quarter, marking an increase of 1.2% compared to the previous period. The number of unemployed individuals worldwide reached 220 million, with 40% of them being long-term unemployed. Additionally, youth unemployment stood at 13.6%, affecting 73 million young people. The report also highlighted that women were disproportionately impacted by job losses during this period. Notably, the Asia-Pacific region experienced the largest increase in unemployment rates, reaching 5.9%. These figures underscore the significant economic challenges faced by individuals worldwide due to the ongoing effects of the pandemic.

data.title: Okta Names Helen Riley to Board of Directors
data.description: Okta, Inc. (Nasdaq: OKTA), a prominent independent identity provider, recently welcomed Helen Riley to their board of directors. The appointment is effective as of today and she brings over 20 years of extensive financial and operational expertise gained from working at organizations focused on tackling complex issues using AI technology. Todd McKinnon, Okta CEO and Co-Founder, expressed his enthusiasm for Riley’s appointment, stating that her insights will be invaluable as the company capitalizes on the expanding opportunity to enhance AI security.

data.title: Apogee Enterprises Completes Acquisition of GroGlass
data.description: Apogee Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: APOG), a key player in architectural building products and services, along with high-performance coated materials, has successfully finalized the acquisition of SIA “GroGlass” ("Groglass"). This deal, valued at around $71.8 million based on current exchange rates, involves potential additional earnout considerations. The acquisition was concluded after meeting the necessary requirements.

data.title: Omega Flex, Inc. Announces Regular Quarterly Dividend for the Third Quarter 2026
data.description: On September 18, 2026, in Exton, Pennsylvania, Omega Flex, Inc. announced a regular quarterly dividend of $0.34 per share. This dividend will be payable on October 14, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors will assess the Company's cash requirements, financial health, capital expenditure plans, potential acquisitions, and other relevant factors on a quarterly basis to determine the amount of future regular quarterly dividends.

data.title: XCharge Reports First Half 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description: On September 18, 2026, XCHG Limited, a leading global provider of high-power EV charging solutions, announced its unaudited financial results for the first half of 2026. The company, based in Hamburg, Germany and Austin, Texas, operates under the ticker symbol Nasdaq: XCH. The report covers the six-month period ending on June 30, 2026.
